name: 88 Chinese
description: 88 Chinese serves Chinese and seafood dishes near Thunmulla. Google reviewers mention a broad menu, generous portions and friendly service.

name: Peach Valley Chinese Restaurant
description: Peach Valley serves Chinese food on Flower Road in Colombo 7. The sampled Google reviews praise the food and friendly service, though one diner notes high prices.

name: Ministry of Crab
description: Ministry of Crab serves crab and prawns in Colombo's Old Dutch Hospital complex. Both Google reviewers sampled praise the crab and attentive staff, but describe the meal as expensive.

name: Nuga Gama
description: Nuga Gama serves Sri Lankan dishes including hoppers, curries and traditional desserts in Colombo. The sampled Google reviews praise the food selection and caring service, while one diner found the live entertainment loud.

name: Flow
description: FLOW at Hilton Residences on Union Place serves international food. The two Google reviews sampled praise the food and welcoming service, with one describing thoughtful care during an anniversary dinner.

name: Shanghai Terrace
description: Shanghai Terrace serves Chinese food on Kotte Road in Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte. The sampled Google reviews praise generous portions and warm service, though one diner reports cold cuttlefish and poor handling of a complaint.

name: Sushi-Kai
description: Sushi-Kai serves Japanese food on Thimbirigasyaya Road in Jawatte. Google reviewers mention sushi platters, mixed tempura and sashimi, with a returning diner praising consistent food and service.

name: Chinese Dragon Cafe
description: Chinese Dragon Cafe's Rajagiriya branch serves Chinese food on Kotte Road. The sampled Google reviews praise the food, portions and helpful staff, while also suggesting improvements to the ambience and upkeep.

name: Shang Palace
description: Shang Palace is at the Shangri-La hotel on Galle Face in Colombo. One Google reviewer praises the roast duck, other dishes and cocktails.
